personality_one_liner: A clean, highly legible, and structured learning environment that feels both officially sanctioned and effortlessly modern.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. No cramped cards. Distinct structural margins with bottom safe area clearance.

do's: Sticky bottom CTA container in Mock Test
Header background when content scrolls behind
dont's: Exam Palette overlay if it affects legibility

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry point for postal employees with email or Google.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top spanning 40% height. Clean white card spanning bottom 60% with inputs, solid brandPrimary CTA. Safe area respected.

screens.name: Student Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Central hub showing active validity, purchased tests, and new test recommendations.

states.empty: Illustration of studying with 'Explore Exam Passes' CTA.
states.error: Error fetching data with a retry button.

screens.layout: Top portion features a Deep Navy (brandTertiary) header with white greeting and active pass validity. Below this: Horizontal scrolling row for 'My Mock Tests' (surfaceSecondary cards with progress bars). Vertical list for 'Recommended Passes' (Combo vs Single). Bottom Tab Bar.

screens.name: Live Mock Test Interface
screens.purpose: Simulated exam environment with timer, bilingual options, and question palette.
screens.layout: Header: Timer (mono font) and Submit/Pause icons. Sub-header: Subject tabs (e.g., Math, GK) and EN/HI language toggle. Main Body: Scrollable question card + options. Sticky Bottom Container (Glass): 'Mark for Review', 'Clear', 'Save & Next'. A Floating Action Button (FAB) or Header icon opens the 'Question Palette' Bottom Sheet (grid of question numbers colored by status: Green=Answered, Gray=Unanswered, Navy=Review).

screens.name: Score Analysis & Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Post-exam breakdown of performance and ranking.
screens.layout: Hero card at top showing absolute score and percentile ring chart. Segmented control below: 'Analysis', 'Leaderboard', 'Explanations'. Analysis shows accuracy stats. Leaderboard shows a vertical list of top users. Explanations shows a scrollable list of questions with correct answers highlighted in success color.

screens.name: Wallet & Referral
screens.purpose: Dashboard for token balance and payouts.

states.empty: Illustration of empty wallet, prompt to share code.

screens.layout: Large brandTertiary banner card displaying token balance. A pronounced CTA to 'Claim Payout' (only active if tokens >= 10). Below, a section displaying the unique referral code with a 'Share' icon. Bottom section is a transaction history list.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: In-app control center for management and test uploads.
screens.layout: Restricted access. Grid of utility tiles: User Management, Bulk XLSX Upload, Pricing Config, Payout Requests. Uses standard list layouts inside each module.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality rigorously. Maintain generous padding and use Plus Jakarta Sans + Geist pairings.

Leverage the specific brand colors defined: Department of Post Red (#C8102E) for primary actions, Deep Navy (#002147) for headers and high-contrast hero areas, and Postal Yellow (#FFC72C) for accents/warnings. The Navy is explicitly allowed per the prompt brief.

Implement the live mock test interface meticulously: ensure the timer uses a mono font (Space Grotesk), implement the question palette via @gorhom/bottom-sheet, and make the 'Save & Next' CTA a sticky floating container with an expo-glass-effect background.
For the Question Palette grid: use standard colors (Green for Answered, Gray for Unanswered, Deep Navy for Marked for Review). DO NOT USE PURPLE OR INDIGO.
Implement bilingual toggling (EN/HI) smoothly in the test interface header, ensure UI components gracefully handle variable string lengths.
Ensure all images mapped in the JSON use the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern if text overlays them, as described in the instructions.
Apply Safe Area contexts to all screens properly, especially on the live exam UI where bottom sticky actions shouldn't clash with the home indicator.
